message.name: braintree_find_customer
message.description: Fetch one customer by GraphQL global Customer ID via the `node` query. Returns id, legacyId, name, company, and created-at. To also enumerate stored cards/PayPal accounts use braintree_customer_payment_methods.

message.name: braintree_customer_payment_methods
message.description: List the vaulted payment methods (credit cards, PayPal accounts, etc.) for one customer, by GraphQL global Customer ID. Returns each method's id, legacyId, usage, created-at, and detail type. GraphQL `node { ... on Customer { paymentMethods } }`.

message.name: braintree_void_transaction
message.description: DESTRUCTIVE. Void (cancel) a transaction that has NOT yet settled — e.g. an authorization or one submitted-for-settlement. Use the GraphQL global transaction ID. GraphQL mutation `voidTransaction`. For already-settled transactions use braintree_refund_transaction instead.
